lines.en: label rindorm55p2:
scene rinoutsidemom1
: Dude! How come you never told me you knew my mom?!
lines.zh: : 老兄！你居然从没告诉过我你认识我妈？！

lines.en: : How come you never told me she was so hot?
lines.zh: : 你怎么也从没说过她那么辣？

lines.en: scene rinoutsidemom2
: Wait, really? You think so?
lines.zh: : 等等，真的吗？你这么觉得？
: 难道……

lines.en: : Do you {i}not?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你{i}不{/i}觉得吗？

lines.en: scene rinoutsidemom3
: I don’t know. Not really? I guess I’ve never thought of it before.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。不太觉得？我想我以前从没往这方面想过。

lines.en: : Yeah, I guess I just don’t see it.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我想我就是看不出来。

lines.en: : Didn’t you say something about wanting to marry your mom when you were younger, though?
lines.zh: : 可你不是说你小时候想跟你妈结婚吗？

lines.en: : I was talking about my other mom, obviously.
lines.zh: : 我说的显然是我另一个妈。

lines.en: scene rinoutsidemom4
: But, back to the topic at hand! What the Hell, Sensei?!
lines.zh: : 但是，回到正题！搞什么鬼啊，Sensei？！

lines.en: : I seriously had no idea you two were even related. Though, in hindsight, if I put any amount of thought into it at all, I probably could have figured it out.
lines.zh: : 我是真不知道你们俩是亲戚。不过现在回想起来，只要我稍微动点脑子，大概就能猜到。

lines.en: : It’s not like we’ve known each other for very long or anything. She’s just the newest addition to my cool new adult friend group.
lines.zh: : 我们认识的时间也不算长。她只是我那个超酷的成年新朋友团里的新人。

lines.en: scene rinoutsidemom5
: Since when do you have an adult friend group?! What about me?! Why is everything falling apart all of a sudden?! Stuff like that is supposed to be saved for when we go to the beach!
lines.zh: : 你什么时候有成年朋友团了？！那我呢？！怎么突然之间一切都崩了？！这种事应该留到我们去海边的时候再说啊！

lines.en: : How much do you even know about your mom’s situation, Rin?
lines.zh: : 你到底知道多少你妈的情况，Rin？

lines.en: scene rinoutsidemom6
: Well...how much do {i}you{/i} know? Because it’s plain as day that they’re not together anymore on account of the fact that I am washing her clothes, but I still don’t get {i}how{/i} it happened.
lines.zh: : 嗯……{i}你{/i}知道多少？因为她们已经不在一起了，这是明摆着的事，毕竟我都在给她洗衣服了，可我还是不明白{i}怎么{/i}会变成这样。

lines.en: : I’m going to be trustworthy for once and not reveal anything since this is my “hot boy summer” and I am attempting to turn over a new leaf as a decent person.
lines.zh: : 我这次要做个守得住秘密的人，什么都不说，因为这是我的「hot boy summer」，我正努力洗心革面做个好人。

lines.en: : Okay, first off, stop trying to sound young. Second, it’s hot {i}girl{/i} summer. Third, you weren’t even {i}close{/i} to using that term right. Fourth, you are a bad person. Fifth-
lines.zh: : 好，首先，别装嫩。第二，是 hot {i}girl{/i} summer。第三，你那个词用得{i}差远{/i}了。第四，你是个坏人。第五——

lines.en: : How many numbers are there going to be? Because I’m starting to think I don’t have time for this.
lines.zh: : 到底还有几条啊？我开始觉得我没时间听下去了。

lines.en: : Just seven more. Fifth, you-
lines.zh: : 还有七条。第五，你——

lines.en: : Okay, moving right along- just get all of the details from Rika if you really want to know what went down.
lines.zh: : 好了，直接跳过——你真想知道发生了什么，去问 Rika 本人就行了。

lines.en: : Unless you two are on weird terms or something. Which I’m starting to think you might be on account of the fact that she still hasn’t met Otoha and that you don’t find her attractive.
lines.zh: : 除非你们俩关系有点奇怪什么的。我开始怀疑是了，毕竟她到现在还没见过 Otoha，而且你觉得她不吸引人。

lines.en: : Would not wanting to fuck my mom really put us on weird terms?
lines.zh: : 我不想跟我妈上床，这真的会让我们关系奇怪吗？

lines.en: : Probably. It’s the first girl I’ve ever encountered that you don’t want to have sex with.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。她是我见过的第一个你不想跟她上床的女生。

lines.en: : Well, two counting Molly.
lines.zh: : 嗯，算上 Molly 是第二个。

lines.en: : Oof.
lines.zh: : 哎哟。

lines.en: scene rinoutsidemom7

: We’re not on weird terms or anything. I wouldn’t have invited her to stay with me if we were. And the Otoha thing is...well, suddenly a lot harder to approach. So I’m still trying to figure out what to do.
lines.zh: : 我们关系一点都不奇怪。要是奇怪，我也不会邀请她来跟我住了。Otoha 那件事……嗯，突然变得难办多了。所以我还在想怎么办。

lines.en: : Otoha’s...Well, she’s got some issues or...doubts about same-sex couples. And I’ve always pitched my parents to her as the perfect example of how it’s done and how it can work.
lines.zh: : Otoha 嘛……她对同性情侣有点心结，或者说是疑虑。而我一直把我爸妈当成完美范例推销给她，告诉她这事行得通。

lines.en: : But considering the fact that {i}that{/i} relationship is now knocking on death’s door, it doesn’t really make my pitch all that reliable, does it?
lines.zh: : 但考虑到我爸妈{i}那段{/i}关系现在已经在敲鬼门关了，这套说辞也不太靠得住了吧？

lines.en: : No...but you can’t hide her forever, you know?
lines.zh: : 是啊……可你也不可能永远把她藏着，你知道吧？

lines.en: scene rinoutsidemom8
: Of course. I know it’s only a matter of time.
lines.zh: : 当然。我知道这只是时间问题。

lines.en: : I just think that waiting until she’s not {i}living in my room{/i} is probably for the best right now since I don’t want Otoha thinking I’ve just been lying about how functional my life is.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，眼下最好等她不{i}住我房间{/i}了再说，因为我不想让 Otoha 觉得我一直在拿自己生活有多正常来骗她。

lines.en: : You have one of the most dysfunctional lives I know, Rin.
lines.zh: : 你的人生可是我认识的人里最不正常的之一了，Rin。

lines.en: : Me, personally? Sure. But apart from the whole being adopted thing, my home life was always totally normal and not at all {i}dysfunctional.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我本人吗？那倒是。但除了被领养那件事，我的家庭生活一直完全正常，一点都不{i}糟糕{/i}。

lines.en: : They always say that children are a reflection of their parents. And while my mom is great, you’ve gotta admit that she’s been in better shape, right?
lines.zh: : 人家都说孩子是父母的镜子。虽然我妈很棒，但你也得承认，她以前状态更好吧？

lines.en: : Beats me. She’s been a wreck ever since I met her. Think the issues with mom number two might run a little deeper than we think.
lines.zh: : 我哪知道。我认识她以来她一直是一团糟。我看二号妈的问题可能比我们想的要深。

lines.en: I expertly pretend like I have no idea what I’m talking about and keep my “hot boy summer (whatever that means)” alive.
lines.zh: 我熟练地装作自己什么也不知道，把我的「hot boy summer（管它什么意思）」继续下去。

lines.en: scene rinoutsidemom9
: Wow. You really weren’t kidding when you said you haven’t known each other long, have you?
lines.zh: : 哇。你说你们认识不久，还真是没夸张啊。

lines.en: : I only see her on Fridays, really. And even then we haven’t exactly talked much.
lines.zh: : 其实我基本上只在周五见她。而且就算那样，我们也没怎么说过话。

lines.en: : She reminds me a lot of you, though.
lines.zh: : 不过她让我想起你很多。

lines.en: : She does? How?
lines.zh: : 是吗？哪里像？

lines.en: : Just in the fact that she’s easy to get along with and clings to others as if it’s second nature.
lines.zh: : 就是她很好相处，而且黏人黏得像本能一样。

lines.en: scene rinoutsidemom10
: Clings to...others...
scene rinoutsidemom11
: That’s it!
lines.zh: : 有了！

lines.en: : What’s {i}it?{/i} What does that-
lines.zh: : 什么有了？那到底是——

lines.en: scene rinoutsidemom12
: You have to date my mom!
lines.zh: : 你去跟我妈交往吧！

lines.en: : It’s the shortest and easiest way to solve the issue of her being too dependent on my other mom! Plus, it will help get her out of my room so I can finally introduce her to Otoha!
lines.zh: : 这是解决她太依赖我另一个妈这个问题最短最省事的途径！而且还能帮她搬出我的房间，这样我终于能把她介绍给 Otoha 了！

lines.en: : And...how did you reach that conclusion, exactly?
lines.zh: : 那么……你到底是怎么得出这个结论的？

lines.en: scene rinoutsidemom13
: She’s clingy and you’re obsessed with girls. If she falls in love with you, she won’t need my other mom anymore and she’ll go back to not crying every five minutes.
lines.zh: : 她很黏人，而你又对女生着迷。要是她爱上了你，就不需要我另一个妈了，她也不会每五分钟哭一次了。

lines.en: : You don’t feel weird about me dating your mom?
lines.zh: : 你对我跟你妈交往不觉得别扭？

lines.en: : Nah. You’re already like a dad to me anyway.
lines.zh: : 不会。反正你对我来说已经像个爸了。

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == False:
: Even though we’ve made out?
lines.zh: : 哪怕我们还接吻过？

lines.en: : I’m technically an orphan. Chances are that sort of thing would have happened if I had a foster dad anyway.
lines.zh: : 我严格来说是个孤儿。要是我有个养父，这种事大概也会发生吧。

lines.en: : I feel like saying that doesn’t exactly set a good example for other orphans or...foster fathers out there.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这话对其他孤儿或者……养父们可算不上什么好榜样。

lines.en: else:
: Gee, thanks. I feel myself falling further into the friend zone every single day.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，谢了。我感觉自己每天都在往朋友区里越陷越深。

lines.en: : Maybe you’ll find Chika down there as well and not have to feel so alone?
lines.zh: : 说不定你在下面还能碰见 Chika，就不至于那么孤单了？

lines.en: : Okay, you really need to get over that.
lines.zh: : 好了，你真的该翻篇了。

lines.en: : Fuck you.
lines.zh: : 去你的。

lines.en: : Besides, if anyone is going to date your mom, it should be Imani.
lines.zh: : 再说了，真要有人跟你妈交往，那也该是 Imani。

lines.en: scene rinoutsidemom14
: Why should it be Imani?
lines.zh: : 为什么该是 Imani？

lines.en: : Because those two have already made out.
lines.zh: : 因为她俩已经亲过了。

lines.en: scene rinoutsidemom15
: My mom made out with Imani?!
lines.zh: : 我妈跟 Imani 亲过？！

lines.en: : Yeah. It was awesome.
lines.zh: : 对啊。超带劲。

lines.en: : I want to make out with Imani!
lines.zh: : 我也想跟 Imani 亲！

lines.en: : You have a girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 你有女朋友的。

lines.en: : She wants to make out with Imani too! We all do! Imani is hot!
lines.zh: : 她也想跟 Imani 亲！我们都想！Imani 超辣！

lines.en: : Also, what about Futaba? I thought you wanted me to be with {i}her?{/i}
lines.zh: : 还有，Futaba 呢？你不是想让我跟{i}她{/i}在一起吗？

lines.en: if harukasex == True:
Haruka as well, but...I’m pretty sure that might just be some sort of sexual fantasy of Rin’s and not something she actually sees working out any time soon.
lines.zh: 还有 Haruka，不过……我敢说那大概只是 Rin 的某种性幻想，不是她真觉得短期内能成的事。

lines.en: : Dating your mom would throw a wrench in that plan, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 那跟我妈交往不就把这个计划搞砸了吗？

lines.en: scene rinoutsidemom16
: Ahh, fuck...you’re right. Futaba would feel super betrayed and used if you started seeing my mom right after taking her virginity.
lines.zh: : 啊，操……你说得对。Futaba 会觉得超级背叛、超级被利用，如果你刚夺走她的初夜就转头跟我妈在一起。

lines.en: : Oh. So I guess that’s a thing you know now. Thanks, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 哦。看来这事你现在也知道了。谢了啊，Futaba。

lines.en: scene rinoutsidemom17
: How was it?
lines.zh: : 感觉怎么样？

lines.en: : Are you seriously asking me for a review of sex with your best friend?
lines.zh: : 你认真的吗？你在问我要一份跟你最好朋友上床的评测？

lines.en: : Is that weird?
lines.zh: : 这很奇怪吗？

lines.en: : No. It was great. But now you have to tell me how sex with Otoha is whenever you two get there.
lines.zh: : 不。很棒。不过以后你们俩走到那一步，你得告诉我跟 Otoha 做爱是什么感觉。

lines.en: : I touched her boobs for like five minutes once. That was cool. They’re very...firm. Real quality breasts. A lot different from Futaba’s.
lines.zh: : 我摸了她大概五分钟的胸。那感觉不错。非常……结实。质量上乘的乳房。跟 Futaba 的差别很大。

lines.en: : If you’ve groped Futaba as well, it seems only fair that I get to grope Otoha next.
lines.zh: : 既然你也摸过 Futaba，那接下来让我摸 Otoha 才公平吧。

lines.en: : I mean...
scene rinoutsidemom18
: So long as it’s all three of us...but I don’t really think she looks at you that way.
lines.zh: : 只要是我们三个一起就行……不过我真不觉得她对你有那个意思。

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == True:
: Which is great news for me since you won’t be able to beat me to having sex with her while I’m nervously lagging behind.
lines.zh: : 这对我来说可是好消息，因为我一直紧张地落在后面，你也就没法抢在我前面跟她上床了。

lines.en: : I don’t think she looks at me that way either. But I’m glad to hear that this threesome isn’t entirely impossible as I was starting to think you were losing interest in me.
lines.zh: : 我也不觉得她对我有那个意思。不过听到三人行并非完全没可能，我还是挺高兴的，因为我开始以为你对我失去兴趣了。

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == True:
scene rinoutsidemom19
: And why exactly would I be interested in you after all you’ve done to me?
lines.zh: : 你对我做了那么多事之后，我凭什么还要对你有兴趣？

lines.en: : Because even if you’re mad at me for everything I did, you keep me close to your heart. Which means there must be {i}something{/i} there, right?
lines.zh: : 因为就算你为我做的一切在生我的气，你还是把我放在心上。那就说明那里还是{i}有东西{/i}的，对吧？

lines.en: : It’s not like I’d tell you if there was. Especially not when I already have someone I care about more than...almost anything.
lines.zh: : 就算有，我也不会告诉你。尤其是在我已经有了比……几乎所有东西都更在乎的人的时候。

lines.en: else:
scene rinoutsidemom20
: What...What exactly do you mean by that?
lines.zh: : 你……你这话到底是什么意思？

lines.en: : I already told you that Otoha’s the one I-
lines.zh: : 我说过了，Otoha 才是我——

lines.en: : For the sake of your impulsiveness and the fragility of both your heart and relationship, I’m going to keep my mouth shut.
lines.zh: : 考虑到你的冲动，还有你的心和你这段感情的脆弱，我决定闭嘴。

lines.en: : Regardless, I just feel like the two of us have been getting a lot more...distant ever since you started seeing Otoha.
lines.zh: : 不管怎么说，我就是觉得……自从你开始跟 Otoha 交往，我们俩变得……疏远多了。

lines.en: : Which I don’t blame you for, of course. She's the one you care the most about and I can’t expect to just change that by having a penis and talking to you.
lines.zh: : 当然我不怪你。她才是你最在乎的人，我也不可能靠有个阴茎、陪你说说话就改变这一点。

lines.en: : We’re just not as close as we used to be, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我们只是没有以前那么亲近了，我猜。

lines.en: : But if that’s just me talking too much, I-
lines.zh: : 但如果只是我话太多，我——

lines.en: : No...You’re right.
lines.zh: : 不……你说得对。

lines.en: scene rinoutsidemom21
: I feel the same way. And I miss you.
lines.zh: : 我也是这么觉得。而且我想你。

lines.en: : I was actually really upset for a day or two after I heard about the virginity thing from Futaba.
lines.zh: : 从 Futaba 那儿听说初夜那件事之后，我真的难过了那么一两天。

lines.en: : Not just because I wasn’t there, though. But because you didn’t even think to come to me about it and I feel like you {i}would{/i} have if this were still...
lines.zh: : 不光是因为我不在场。而是因为你根本没想到来找我，我觉得如果这还是……

lines.en: scene rinoutsidemom22
: The beginning of...
lines.zh: : 那一切的……

lines.en: : The...school...wait, what month is it?
lines.zh: : 那个……学校……等等，现在几月来着？

lines.en: scene rinoutsidemom23
: A-Anyway! You’re totally right. It’s just really hard for me right now to find time for both of you.
lines.zh: : 总——总之！你说得完全对。只是我现在很难同时腾出时间给你们两个。

lines.en: : I want things to be as normal as possible for Otoha since she’s still so, uhh...anxious about everything. And when I’m with you, I...
lines.zh: : 我想让 Otoha 的一切尽可能正常，因为她对什么都还那么……呃，焦虑。而我跟你在一起的时候，我……

lines.en: scene rinoutsidemom24
: I get a little too excited.
lines.zh: : 我会变得有点太兴奋。

lines.en: : I don’t want her to feel like she’s moving down my priority list. And she's actually really sensitive despite always seeming so cool and collected.
lines.zh: : 我不想让她觉得自己在我心里的排位下降了。而她其实特别敏感，虽然看起来总是又酷又冷静。

lines.en: : But that’s not fair to you either since you’re...a good friend of mine...
lines.zh: : 可这对你也不公平，因为你是……我的好朋友……

lines.en: : And one that, even with all of the hiccups, I still cherish.
lines.zh: : 而且就算中间有那么多磕磕绊绊，我依然很珍惜。

lines.en: scene rinoutsidemom25
: There’s always a place for you in my heart, Sensei. And even if it feels like the walls are caving in, I can guarantee you that place isn’t shrinking at all.
lines.zh: : 我心里永远有你的位置，Sensei。就算你觉得四面墙都在往里塌，我敢保证那个位置一点都没有变小。

lines.en: : The rest of it’s just getting bigger.
lines.zh: : 只是其他部分变大了而已。

lines.en: : I can accept that. Like I said, I understand it and don’t hold anything against you. The top priority right now is keeping things stable with Otoha.
lines.zh: : 我能接受。就像我说的，我理解，也不怪你。眼下的首要任务是稳住跟 Otoha 的关系。

lines.en: : Which means that I will have to take one for the team and fuck your mom. But remember, Rin- I am only doing this for {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 也就是说，我得为了大局牺牲一下，去跟你妈上床。但记住，Rin——我这么做全是为了{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : Woah, hold on. Nobody said anything about {i}fucking.{/i} I was just suggesting that you make her {i}want{/i} to fuck you since that would keep her sane long enough to look like a functional adult in front of Otoha.
lines.zh: : 哇，等等。谁说要{i}上床{/i}了。我只是建议你让她{i}想{/i}跟你上床，这样她就能保持清醒足够久，好在 Otoha 面前看起来像个正常的成年人。

lines.en: : But if you’re planning on making me a little brother or sister, I don’t think I-
lines.zh: : 但如果你打算给我添个弟弟妹妹，我觉得我——

lines.en: scene rinoutsidemom26
: Wait...
lines.zh: : 等等……

lines.en: : Rin?
lines.zh: : Rin？

lines.en: : Shut up, I’m thinking.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，我在想事情。

lines.en: : I was just joking, you know. There’s no way I’m going to impregnate your-
lines.zh: : 我开玩笑的，你知道吧。我不可能让你妈——

lines.en: : Call me “onee-chan” but do it in like, a...girly voice. I think I might want a little sister.
lines.zh: : 叫我「姐姐」，但要用……那种，很女生的声音。我觉得我可能想要个妹妹。

lines.en: : I don’t think I’m capable of making a girly voice. Nor am I willing to call you “onee-chan.”
lines.zh: : 我觉得我发不出女生的声音。我也不愿意叫你「姐姐」。

lines.en: scene rinoutsidemom27
: Ugh. You’re no fun. Guess I’ll just be an only child forever because no one will have sex with my mom.
lines.zh: : 呃。你真没劲。看来我要当一辈子独生女了，因为没一个人愿意跟我妈上床。

lines.en: : Wait, so {i}am{/i} I supposed to have sex with Rika? Or am I not supposed to do that? Because I feel like you’ve flipped positions over the last two minutes.
lines.zh: : 等等，所以我到底{i}该不该{/i}跟你妈上床？还是不该？我感觉你这几分钟立场翻转了好几次。

lines.en: scene rinoutsidemom28
: I don’t know, man. Do whatever you want. I still think my parents are going to get back together, but my mom could definitely use a good “magic missile” right now.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，老兄。你爱干嘛干嘛。我还是觉得我爸妈会和好，不过我妈现在确实很需要一发「魔法飞弹」。

lines.en: : Please don’t call it that ever again.
lines.zh: : 求你以后别再这么叫了。

lines.en: : Whatever happens, just don’t tell Futaba about it. Or {i}me.{/i} I don’t want to know.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，别告诉 Futaba。也别告诉{i}我{/i}。我不想知道。

lines.en: : Finding out you banged my mom would be, like...the weirdest form of NTR ever.
lines.zh: : 知道你把我妈睡了，那大概是……史上最诡异的 NTR 了。

lines.en: : And now that I’m leveling with you, I might as well add that I have no clue if the dating thing would even work in the first place. I’m just running out of ideas over here, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 既然我都跟你交心了，我也不妨加上一句：我压根不知道交往这事到底行不行得通。我实在没辙了，Sensei。

lines.en: : I desperately want things to work out with Otoha and me. But it’s mega stressful feeling like I have to fucking choreograph my entire life to make it work.
lines.zh: : 我拼命想让我和 Otoha 能成。可是感觉我得他妈把自己整个人生编排好才能让它运转，这压力太大了。

lines.en: : Maybe I just need to get laid too. That sounds like it would help.
lines.zh: : 也许我也该去睡个人。听起来会有帮助。

lines.en: : I’ve felt that way since the day I met you and agree that it would probably turn your life around.
lines.zh: : 我从认识你那天起就这么觉得了，也同意这大概能让你的人生翻个面。

lines.en: : Sometimes, I feel like I’m going to die a virgin.
lines.zh: : 有时候我觉得自己会到死都是处男。

lines.en: : Not if I have anything to do with it.
lines.zh: : 只要有我在，就不会。

lines.en: scene rinoutsidemom29
: That would certainly fix our “distance” problem, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 那确实能解决我们的「距离」问题，是吧？

lines.en: if harukasex == True:
: Yes, but I have already wrecked your boss’s home and plucked her from the clutches of another man. Destroying one more might make me a bad person.
lines.zh: : 是，但我已经毁了你老板的家，还把她从别的男人手里抢了过来。再毁一个，我可能就成坏人了。

lines.en: : Maybe. But on the bright side, it would mean that Haruka, Futaba, {i}and{/i} me all got boned by the same person! We’d have something to bone over! I mean...bond.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。但往好处想，这意味着 Haruka、Futaba {i}和{/i}我都被同一个人睡过了！我们就有共同话题可以「干」了！我是说……聊。

lines.en: else:

: It would. But I’ve got a good streak so far of not having sex with people in relationships. So just keep hoping Otoha takes your pants off while I pretend that I won’t be fantasizing about that later.
lines.zh: : 确实。不过到目前为止，我一直保持着不跟有对象的人上床的好记录。所以你就继续盼着 Otoha 把你的裤子脱了吧，我这边就假装自己待会儿不会去幻想那个场面。

lines.en: : Don’t worry. The amount of time I will spend fantasizing about that will more than make up for it.
lines.zh: : 放心。我花在幻想那件事上的时间，足够补回来了。

lines.en: scene rinoutsidemom30
: So...we cool? No longer worried that I’m gonna just slowly wean you out of my life?
lines.zh: : 那么……我们和好了？不再担心我会慢慢把你从我的生活里挤出去了？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t ever let that happen anyway since you’re such an essential part of mine.
lines.zh: : 反正我也不会让那种事发生的，因为你是我生命里不可或缺的一部分。

lines.en: : Likewise, homie.
lines.zh: : 彼此彼此，兄弟。

lines.en: : Let’s...get together soon. Find time for just the two of us and see if we can get things back to the way they were before all of the chaos and stress and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我们……找时间聚聚吧。就我们两个，看看能不能把一切恢复成那些混乱和压力之前的样子。

lines.en: scene rinoutsidemom31
: But, for now...I’ve got a load of laundry to finish.
lines.zh: : 不过眼下……我还有一堆衣服要洗。

lines.en: : Thanks for letting me vent a little bit. And for not telling me when you ultimately sleep with my mom.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你听我发牢骚。也谢谢你最后真睡了我妈的时候不告诉我。

lines.en: : And...thanks for your blessing, I guess?
lines.zh: : 还有……谢谢你的祝福，大概？

lines.en: scene black
Rin heads back into the dorm- and while I should be narrating about how this conversation went way better than I expected it to...really all I can think about is having sex with her mom.
lines.zh: Rin 回了宿舍——按理说我该旁白一下，说这场对话比我预想的顺利得多……可我现在满脑子只剩跟她妈上床这件事。

lines.en: That’s on Rin, though. I was planning on saving those thoughts until I got home later. It’s not my fault they’ve been pushed up.
lines.zh: 不过这得怪 Rin。我本来打算把这些念头留到晚些时候回家再想的。它们被提前了，可不是我的错。

lines.en: The “weirdest form of NTR” aside, though...I’m worried about her.
lines.zh: 话说回来，撇开「史上最诡异的 NTR」不谈……我挺担心她的。

lines.en: She’s surprisingly calm for being in such a stressful predicament right now.
lines.zh: 身处这么让人焦虑的处境，她却平静得出奇。

lines.en: And all I can hope is that it doesn’t wind up getting to her.
lines.zh: 我唯一能指望的，是这别最后把她压垮。

lines.en: Or that something else doesn’t get to her first.
lines.zh: 或者说，别有什么别的东西先压垮她。
